title: the floor links a class verb that landed after the first wiring walk
intention: Every executable verb in a device's class-space 0/bin is linked at its instance-space address by bin/cairn's floor, including verbs and devices that landed after the box's first wiring walk.
why: Measured 2026-11-12. On akiendelllinux, ~/.cairn/devices/web_server/0/bin/web_server was absent, so cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_cli_reaches.py redded and blocked 59f7456dd9f5's PROVED; the orchestrator laid the link by hand. On akienasus every instance link was laid at one moment (2026-11-11 15:29:12, the reinstall's first walk), web_server's was laid by hand on 11-12 at 17:00, and librarian/0/bin/question (class file 11-12 11:17) has no instance link at all. Cause: bin/cairn's _floor runs cairn_wire_instances only when cairn/0 is absent or the superclaude launcher is not executable; after the first walk, a new class verb is linked only when a hand dispatches its device through bin/cairn.
traces_to: Law 1 (a launcher laid by hand on every box re-derives a settled answer) and Law 4 (the wiring rule is physics only on a first run; afterwards it is a hand's memory).
how: In bin/cairn's _floor, the full-walk trigger widens from 'superclaude/0/bin/superclaude is not executable' to 'that, OR any executable file cairn/devices/<dev>/0/bin/<verb> has neither -e nor -L at $INSTANCE_ROOT/<dev>/0/bin/<verb>'. It is a bash loop over the class bins, and it breaks at the first gap. The walk itself, cairn_wire_instances in cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh, is unchanged. New red-first proof bin/proofs/test_the_floor_links_a_class_verb_that_landed_late.py, using the pattern of bin/proofs/test_superclaude_is_never_refused_by_the_floor.py (same env: CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT under a scratch home, CAIRN_VENV, CAIRN_PG_SOCKET_DIR, CAIRN_BOOT_LOG, fake sudo on PATH). Tooth 1: pre-make $root/cairn/0 and run bin/cairn superclaude --dry-run once so superclaude and the walk are laid. Then remove the web_server/0/bin/web_server link from the scratch root (scratch, not instance-space). Run bin/cairn superclaude --dry-run again, and assert the link is back and resolves to cairn/devices/web_server/0/bin/web_server. Tooth 2: put a real file at the scratch librarian/0/bin/question, run once, and assert it is still a real file with the same bytes.

clauses.claim: with cairn/0 and the superclaude launcher present and a class verb's instance link absent, one bin/cairn run links that verb to its class file
a hand-placed real file at a class verb's instance address is left untouched by that run

decisions.text: D1: _floor's walk trigger adds the any-class-verb-unlinked predicate; the recipe stays in recovery.
D2: the proof is new, two teeth, the superclaude floor proof's env.

measured.saw: akienasus: every ~/.cairn/devices/*/0/bin link dated 2026-11-11 15:29:12 except web_server (11-12 17:00, by hand); librarian/0/bin/question has no instance link though cairn/devices/librarian/0/bin/question is executable
measured.how: for each cairn/devices/*/0/bin/<verb>, test -L / -e at ~/.cairn/devices/<dev>/0/bin/<verb>, and ls -l --time-style=+%F_%T
